# Getting help

Start with the [official Neconyan handbook](https://platberlitz.github.io/neconyan-docs/) for questions about using the app.

If something isn't working, follow the [troubleshooting guide](https://platberlitz.github.io/neconyan-docs/help/troubleshooting/). If the problem persists, [open a bug report](https://github.com/platberlitz/Neconyan/issues/new/choose) with the steps you tried and what happened.

For missing or unclear instructions, [open an issue in the handbook repository](https://github.com/platberlitz/neconyan-docs/issues).
